checksums.name: magic_prefix_sum16_be
checksums.formula_detail: u16 sum (mod 65536) of only the first 4 bytes of the slot: sum(slot[0:4]) & 0xFFFF, i.e. 'S'+'O'+'N'+'I'=0x53+0x4F+0x4E+0x49=0x0139, stored BIG-ENDIAN at 0xFFE (high) / 0xFFF (low). FUN_08049718 loops uVar2<4 over byte pointer at save base. Payload bytes 4..0xFFD are NOT covered.

io_driver_functions.notes: Flash autoselect/ID read: unlock 0xAA->[0x5555], 0x55->[0x2AAA] (DAT-scaled), 0x90, read ID bytes at 0x0E000000, 0xF0 reset; returns (mfr<<8)|device via FUN_080608a4 byte-read trampoline
IdentifyFlash/select config: calls FUN_0805ff44, walks chip table comparing ID short at entry+0x28, copies entry +0x00..+0x14 fields to driver globals (incl. shift at +8 used for sector addressing)

ReadFlash(sector_index, dst_offset, dst, len=0x1000): sets WAITCNT bits |3, bank-switch via FUN_0805ff20 if chip size==0x20000 (Flash 1M), addr=0x0E000000+(index<<shift)+offset, copies via RAM-resident FUN_0806089c trampoline; code copied to stack first (FUN_08060134 pattern)
WriteFlash(sector_index, src, len=0x1000): mirror of FUN_08060198, addr=0x0E000000+(index<<shift), via FUN_0806089c
EraseSector(index<0x10): unlock 0xAA/0x55, 0x80, 0xAA/0x55, 0x30 at sector addr 0x0E000000+(index<<shift); copies routine to stack via FUN_08060134, poll via FUN_0806089c(2,addr,0xFF,...)
ProgramByte: unlock 0xAA/0x55, 0xA0, *dst=*src byte program, via FUN_0806089c
Copy flash-driver routine from ROM (between two DAT bounds) into a stack/RAM buffer so it can execute while flash is busy/unmapped
Set flash type/size selector (param<=3) storing type index and derived table pointer; gate for erase/write retry loops
sum16 of first 4 bytes only (see checksums)
SWI 0x0B (CpuSet) wrapper used as memcpy for high-score entries and small field copies

caller_chains.trigger_context: Boot/load: FUN_08048d94 zeroes RAM save struct and calls FUN_08060420 IdentifyFlash; FUN_08048dcc reads all 10 slots (FUN_08060198 len 0x1000), validates magic(8B)+checksum, picks max counter, copies scores +0x22C->work+0x1E0, fields +0x30/+0x36/+0x3A, settings +0xCC/+0xCE, config via FUN_0803a098; if none valid -> FUN_080492e4
caller_chains.how_mapped: Direct calls read in decompiled.c body of FUN_08048dcc; callgraph.json only lists 0x08048d94/0x0803a098/0x08002f14 as callees because remaining calls go through func_0x0806xxxx indirect trampolines Ghidra did not resolve - mapping is by explicit func_0x08060198/0x08049718 call sites in the C body, cross-checked against callgraph for the resolved edges

caller_chains.trigger_context: No valid slot on load (or new game): FUN_08060008(3) selects flash type, erases/validates 10 slots via FUN_08060894 loop, FUN_080494c8 builds default struct, writes slot 0 via erase (FUN_08060898) + FUN_080602fc(0,src,0x1000) retry x3
caller_chains.how_mapped: Decompiled body of FUN_080492e4 + FUN_080494c8 field writes matched byte-for-byte against observed sav defaults

caller_chains.trigger_context: Save/flush: increments 64-bit counter +8/+0xC, recomputes checksum (FUN_08049718) stored BE at 0xFFE/0xFFF, slot=(counter-1)%10 via 64-bit mod helper FUN_08060ef4, erase+write FUN_080602fc(slot,RAM struct,0x1000) with up to 3 retries gated by FUN_08060008/FUN_08060898
caller_chains.how_mapped: Decompiled body; verified empirically: cap-00 has only slot0 counter=1, cap-01 adds slot1 counter=2 identical otherwise, exactly (2-1)%10=1

caller_chains.trigger_context: Flush trigger: copies working+0x6E0 to +0x72C area, calls FUN_08049640 unless a suppress flag is set (then returns 1 without saving)
Pending-score flush: if save+0x11!=0 and FUN_0805dbd8() value qualifies, sets save+0x14=value, clears +0x11, calls FUN_08049640

open_questions: Exact RAM base address of the save struct: Ghidra DAT literal values are symbolic (_DAT_08049xxx) in the provided decompiled.c, so RAM mirror is proven only as struct-relative offsets (whole 0x1000 struct copied verbatim by FUN_08060198/FUN_080602fc), not an absolute 0x02xxxxxx/0x03xxxxxx address

Semantics of fields at 0x10/0x11/0x14 (value=100), 0x30/0x36/0x3A byte groups, 0xCC/0xCE/0xD0 settings, byte 0x72C, and the 7 config u16s at 0x18 - writers/readers traced but gameplay meaning not derivable clean-room

Whether FUN_08049718's 4-byte loop bound is intentional or a Ghidra artifact: it matches all 3 observed slots exactly and the validator code, but a checksum covering only 'SONI' is degenerate - fuzzing target 3 tests this directly
Fourth default u16 write in FUN_080494c8 via unresolved DAT offset (after +0xD0) - no corresponding nonzero byte observed
FUN_08060890..0x080608a4 trampolines and FUN_0805ff20 bank switch are unresolved jumptables in the decompilation; their roles are inferred from call sites, not proven

Load selection quirk: FUN_08048dcc stores counter_lo truncated to u16 (uVar11=(ushort)...) and forces selection when counter_hi!=0 - behaviour for counters >0xFFFF is a hypothesis from code reading only
